definitions.explanation: Having little length. The opposite of {長|なが}い (long).
Lasting only a brief amount of time.

examples.english: Life is short, so let's treasure every day.

notes:
{短|みじか}い is an i-adjective meaning short in length or duration.

FORMS:
- Adverb: {短|みじか}く
- Make shorter: {短|みじか}く⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧
- Noun form: {短|みじか}さ (shortness)
- Moderative: ⟦{短|みじか}め→短め：20900_mijikame⟧ (somewhat short, on the short side)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{髪|かみ}→髪：02196_kami⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{短|みじか}い: to have short hair
- ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{短|みじか}い: time is short
- ⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{短|みじか}い: the period is short
- {短|みじか}く⟦まとめる→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧: to summarize briefly

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{気|き}→気：02199_ki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{短|みじか}い: short-tempered, impatient. A fixed expression about personality, not about physical length; it has its own entry at ⟦{気|き}が{短|みじか}い→気が短い：06882_kigamijikai⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧: long (antonym)
- ⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧: low (height, not length)
